explanation: Matches the first question on erdosproblems.com/1174: there is a K₄-free graph such that every ℕ-colouring of its edges has a monochromatic triangle. Colourings are given on all of Sym2 V, which is harmless because only edge values are consulted. It is open in ZFC, with only Shelah's consistency result known, and stated affirmatively.
